claims: The Artemis II Orion capsule reaches a maximum speed of approximately 25,000 mph (40,000 km/h) during its reentry into Earth's atmosphere.
The Artemis II Orion capsule reentry into Earth's atmosphere is one of the fastest human-rated flights in history.
Parachutes slow the Artemis II Orion capsule down to a 17 mph splashdown.
The maximum velocity for Artemis 2 is reached just before entry interface.
The trans-lunar injection speed for Artemis 2 is ~24,527 mph (39,472 km/h).
Parachute deployment for Artemis 2 slows the Artemis II Orion capsule to ~300 mph, then 17 mph for landing.
The mid-space cruise speed for Artemis 2 is ~17,000 mph.
